moments.title: UK Summer Holidays Peak
moments.blurb: Schools across England and Wales are in the midst of their summer break, with many families enjoying holidays, while Scottish schools prepare for their mid-August return.

angles.name: Summer Escapes
angles.copy: Halfway through the summer holidays! Whether you're staycationing or jetting off, make the most of every sunny moment. What's your top summer tune?

angles.name: School's Out

moments.title: UK Weather Divide
moments.blurb: Southern England and Wales are bracing for continued hot, dry conditions with temperatures often above 28°C, while northern England, Scotland, and Northern Ireland face cooler, wetter weather.

angles.name: South Bakes, North Drenches
angles.copy: It's a tale of two countries this August! South England & Wales are still feeling the heat, but up north, it's waterproofs on. What's the weather doing where you are?

angles.name: Heatwave Watch
angles.copy: Another week, another heatwave alert for parts of the UK! Stay cool, stay hydrated if you're in the south. Meanwhile, north of the border, it's looking a bit more 'classic British summer'...

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has become the longest-running UK Number 1 single of all time, spending an incredible 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top of the Official Singles Chart.

angles.name: Chart Record Breakers
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK Number 1 single EVER. 19 weeks at the top! Are you still playing it on repeat?

angles.name: The Longest Reign
angles.copy: Move over Frankie Laine, there's a new record holder! 'Rein Me In' by Sam Fender & Olivia Dean has smashed the 73-year record for longest time at UK Number 1. Unbelievable.

moments.title: World Cup Anthem still high in charts
moments.blurb: Shakira and Burna Boy's official FIFA World Cup song 'Dai Dai' remains strong at Number 2 in the UK Official Singles Chart this week.

angles.name: World Cup Hype Continues
angles.copy: The World Cup might be over, but its anthem lives on! Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is still riding high at Number 2. Did this track get you dancing this summer?

angles.name: Shakira & Burna Boy
angles.copy: Still a massive hit! Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' holding firm at #2 on the charts. It's got that undeniable energy.
